class.name: CgameGPUResourceReport
class.brief_description: Estimates GPU memory use of a scene and records a memory timeline.
class.description: [CgameGPUResourceReport] walks a node tree with [method collect] and estimates the video memory held by meshes, materials, textures and shaders. It also adds the [RenderingServer] memory and draw-call totals, the visible and shadow render-pass statistics of the root's viewport, and keeps a ring-buffer timeline of memory samples. All byte figures are [b]estimates[/b]: driver padding, tiling and compression on upload are not visible from the engine API. [ImageTexture] formats are exact (without mipmaps, which cannot be queried); other textures are assumed to be [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] with mipmaps unless [member probe_compressed] is enabled, which reads each texture back for its real format at a high cost. Walked node types: [MeshInstance3D], [MultiMeshInstance3D], [GPUParticles3D], [Decal] and [Sprite3D]. Entries are keyed by object ID, so shared resources are counted once. [codeblock] var report := CgameGPUResourceReport.new() report.collect(get_tree().current_scene) for texture in report.top(3, "textures"): print(texture.name, " ", CgameGPUResourceReport.format_bytes(texture.bytes)) print(report.to_markdown()) [/codeblock]

method.name: collect
method.description: Clears the previous results, walks [param root] and returns [method snapshot]. A [code]null[/code] root yields empty results.

method.name: format_bpp
method.description: Returns the bits per pixel of an [enum Image.Format], or [code]-1[/code] when unknown.

method.name: format_bytes
method.description: Formats [param bytes] as [code]"N B"[/code], [code]"N.N KiB"[/code] or [code]"N.NN MiB"[/code].

method.name: is_block_compressed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for block-compressed image formats (DXT/BC, ETC, ASTC), which round texture dimensions up to whole 4x4 blocks in the estimate.

method.name: rendering_totals
method.description: Returns the current [RenderingServer] totals as a dictionary with the integer keys [code]video_mem[/code], [code]texture_mem[/code], [code]buffer_mem[/code], [code]draw_calls[/code], [code]objects[/code] and [code]primitives[/code].

method.name: snapshot
method.description: Returns the results of the last [method collect] as a dictionary with the arrays [code]meshes[/code], [code]materials[/code], [code]textures[/code] and [code]shaders[/code] (one dictionary per resource), [code]nodes[/code] (counts per node type), [code]passes[/code], [code]rendering[/code] (see [method rendering_totals]) and [code]totals[/code] with [code]mesh_bytes[/code], [code]texture_bytes[/code], [code]instance_bytes[/code], [code]estimated_bytes[/code], [code]vertices[/code], [code]indices[/code] and the resource counts.

method.name: texture_bytes
method.description: Estimates the bytes of a 2D texture of [param width] by [param height] pixels, optionally including the full mip chain, multiplied by [param layers]. Unknown formats are assumed to use 32 bits per pixel. Returns [code]0[/code] for non-positive dimensions.

method.name: timeline
method.description: Returns the recorded timeline samples, oldest first.

method.name: timeline_peak
method.description: Returns the largest value of [param key] (for example [code]video_mem[/code] or [code]estimated_bytes[/code]) among the timeline samples.

method.name: timeline_push
method.description: Records one sample with the current [RenderingServer] totals and the estimate of the last [method collect], and returns it. Once [member timeline_capacity] samples exist, the oldest one is overwritten.

method.name: to_markdown
method.description: Returns a Markdown report with totals, [RenderingServer] figures, render passes, the [param top_n] largest meshes, materials, textures and shaders, and a timeline summary.

method.name: top
method.description: Returns up to [param n] entries of [param kind] ([code]"meshes"[/code], [code]"materials"[/code], [code]"textures"[/code] or [code]"shaders"[/code]) sorted by estimated bytes, largest first. Ties are ordered by name. A negative [param n] returns all entries.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], non-[ImageTexture] textures are read back through [method Texture2D.get_image] to learn their exact format and mipmap state. This is slow.
Maximum number of timeline samples kept.
